source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
3. Record the time and date of the incident. Make sure to note if the time is local or in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

4. Identify the precise location where the incident occurred, including building number, floor, room, or specific work area as well as the GPS coordinates if applicable.

5. List the individuals directly involved in the incident, including their names, roles, departments, and contact information. If there were witnesses, document their information as well.

6. Document the nature of the incident in detail: was it a fall, machinery accident, exposure to chemicals, slip, etc.?

7. Describe the injuries sustained by each person involved. Include the nature and severity of the injuries, whether they required first aid, medical attention, hospitalization, etc.

8. Capture the sequence of events leading up to the incident. This should be a detailed account including all contributing factors.

9. Photograph the scene and any relevant evidence before anything
